Clear Identifying Data for Withdrawn Students

Source: R/withdrawing.R
clear_withdrawn_student_data.Rd

Removes identifying information for students marked as withdrawn. Only rows where the withdrawal indicator equals `"Y"` are updated.

Supports the package's configurable column-name system, accepting either internal identifiers or configured external column names.

Usage

clear_withdrawn_student_data(
  data,
  WithdrawColumn = "withdrawn",
  columns_to_clear = c("upn", "dob", "hex_id", "ome_id"),
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing class list information.

WithdrawColumn

Character string identifying the withdrawal status column. Defaults to `"withdrawn"`, corresponding to `"Withdrawn?"` in the default column-name lookup.

columns_to_clear

Character vector of columns to clear. Defaults to `c("upn", "dob", "print_id", "ome_id")`. Columns not present in the data frame are ignored.

verbose

Logical; if TRUE, prints a summary message.

Value

A data frame with identifying fields set to NA for withdrawn students. Column names are returned using the configured naming convention.

Details

The function:

  1. Converts configured column names to internal names.

  2. Resolves the requested withdrawal and identifying columns.

  3. Identifies records where the withdrawal status is `"Y"`.

  4. Sets the requested identifying fields to NA for these records.

  5. Restores the configured column names.

No student identifier is required. Records are processed individually using the withdrawal indicator.

If the withdrawal column is absent, a warning is issued and the original data frame is returned unchanged.

See also

Other withdrawing: apply_withdrawal(), revert_ignored_withdrawals()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
updated <- clear_withdrawn_student_data(class_list)

updated <- clear_withdrawn_student_data(
  class_list,
  columns_to_clear = c("DOB", "UPN")
)
} # }
